'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian Kharkiv counteroffensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] retake the cities of [[Balakliia]], [[Kupiansk]], and [[Izium]] from [[Russian occupation of Kharkiv Oblast|Russian occupation]]. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] confirms the withdrawal of troops from several towns in [[Kharkiv Oblast]] in order to allow its forces "to regroup" and reinforce the [[Donbas]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62860774 (BBC News)]  [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/ukrainian-forces-capture-strategic-town-27957253 (''Mirror'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed when their boat is hit by a whale and capsizes near [[Kaikōura]], [[New Zealand]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/five-dead-after-boat-capsizes-off-new-zealand-coast-police-2022-09-10/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and five others are injured when a [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk|Black Hawk helicopter]] crashes during a [[Taliban]] training exercise in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/black-hawk-helicopter-crashes-during-taliban-training-exercise-killing-three-2022-09-10/ (Reuters)]
*Eighteen people are killed when a bus and a tanker truck collide and cause an explosion in [[Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-caribbean-monterrey-238f21b5cb59ce9bc1df6834d0919f9a (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Kurds|Kurdish]] administration in [[Syria]], the [[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria]], requests help from the [[World Health Organization]] to contain a [[cholera]] outbreak which has killed three people in the region. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/09/10/Syria-s-Kurds-appeal-for-UN-help-after-three-die-of-cholera (Al Arabiya)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Proclamation of accession of Charles III]]
**Charles Philip Arthur George is proclaimed [[Monarchy of the United Kingdom|King of the United Kingdom]] as [[Charles III]] by the [[Accession Council]] at [[St James's Palace]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-62842089 (BBC News)]
**Charles Philip Arthur George is proclaimed [[Monarchy of Canada|King of Canada]] as Charles III by the [[Chief Herald of Canada]] at [[Rideau Hall]]. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-king-charles-ceremony-rideau-hall-canada/ (''Globe and Mail'')]
**Charles Philip Arthur George is proclaimed [[Monarchy of Australia|King of Australia]] as Charles III by the [[Governor-General of Australia]] [[David Hurley]] at [[Government House, Canberra|Government House]] in [[Canberra]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-09-11/king-charles-proclaimed-australia-monarch/101427102 (ABC News)]
**Charles Philip Arthur George is proclaimed [[Monarchy of New Zealand|King of New Zealand]] as Charles III by the [[New Zealand Herald Extraordinary|Herald of Arms]] at the [[New Zealand Parliament Buildings]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/474542/king-charles-iii-officially-proclaimed-as-new-zealand-s-new-king (Radio New Zealand)]
